title: Armstrong's path from 1929 to the April 1931 band, and who joined when
summary: DeMichael reviews Armstrong's years with Dickerson, New York and Les Hite and his 1931 arrest; Randolph and Lindsay were added to an existing band, and he was not in the band for the Showboat trouble.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Well, you say you and Preston joined the band in Detroit.
No, no. Johnny Lindsay.
I'm sorry, Johnny Lindsay and you joined it in Detroit. Well, who did you replace?
No one.
Oh, he added.
Yeah, Louis added. I don't know who, I don't know who Johnny Lindsay replaced.
Well, that was the same band that made the records -- the '31 band?
Yes, the '31 band, yes.
Well, didn't they play at the Regal before then?

This band -- this band to my knowing never got to the Regal. No, this band never got to the Regal because Collins was the manager of Louie and Collins pulled Louie out from the band in New York and sent us back home and sent Louie over in France.
Well, that was a little later. There's a famous incident, in fact, it was a part of that television show on Louie, at the Showboat --
Yes.
-- where gangsters were trying to make Louie go back to New York and he also got in trouble in California. Let's go back -- Louie left Chicago in 1929, I believe.
Uh-huh.
He was with Carol Dickerson's band -- and went to New York. He made some records and then he left New York and went out to California, and played with Les Hite's band -- fronted Les Hite's band.
That's right, that's right.
And got busted on a pot charge, and
the next month -- that was in March of '31 according to the records. And in April he came back to Chicago and formed this band which --
And played down to -- oh, what was that place he played -- this was the band he played with --
Was that the Showboat?

Yeah, one, two, three, four, five, six -- yes, he played this -- this is the band -- the real truth about this band -- this band -- we played Detroit and we played our way down to -- we went down to New Orleans and we played the Suburban Gardens and we stayed there -- how many months -- we were supposed to stay there four weeks and we stayed there four months -- I remember. Okay.
But before the band went on the road there was this trouble in Chicago at the Showboat.
well, But I wasn't with the band.
You were not in the band?
I wasn't in the band then.
